mass_basis: Illustrative per-link starter masses, not measured or inferred from filled CAD volume
com_basis: Centre of each link-local mesh bounding box, assumed mass distribution
inertia_basis: Uniform solid bounding box about assumed COM; diagonal m*(b*b+c*c)/12; not CAD/physical inertia
collision_basis: One bounding box per physical link; conservative proxy can create false contacts
joint_limit_basis: CAD example range relative to displayed zero, not measured mechanical limits
actuator_basis: Illustrative simulation caps, not MKS/reducer ratings or safe operating commands
tcp_basis: Nominal CAD tool-front +X32mm from Link6; not a calibrated physical TCP
